verdict.rationale: The Skills API (container parameter in Messages API, Skills API for upload/manage, skill_id references) lets developers create, upload, and invoke skills programmatically, mirroring what's available in Claude.ai/Claude Code UI (docs-10, docs-23, docs-24, docs-39, gh-2). However, plugin marketplaces, slash-command invocation (/skill-name, /run, /verify), and plugin management appear to be CLI/UI-only constructs with no documented API equivalent, and there's no explicit vendor statement confirming full UI/API parity. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, API equivalents for plugin marketplace/slash-command features, and independent confirmation that all UI-surfaced skill behaviors are reproducible via API.
